title: 第21章 母女花当然是我亲自去解救啦第22章 足以毁灭中千世界的豪华保镖团出发
slug: 多子多福家族帮我攻略极品仙子
lines: “处境不太好？”江渊挑了挑眉，“怎么说？”
江战挥了挥手，关于树林界烟雨楼的详细情报，便化作一道信息流，涌入江渊的脑海。
树林界，只是三千小世界中，一个毫不起眼的存在。
这个世界的修炼水平极低，
最强者也不过是6境神通境，连飞升到中千世界资格都没有。
而烟雨楼，在树林界也只是一个一流宗门，楼主秦月白，修为在5境法域境巅峰，已经是宗门里的最强者了。
本来，以烟雨楼的实力，偏安一隅，过过自己的小日子，倒也安稳。
坏就坏在，秦月白的并蒂莲华体上。
这两种体质，在帝仙大世界或许不算什么，但树林界木道灵气昌盛，
似并蒂莲华体这种木属性浓郁的道体更是有着很强的战力加成，
再加上树林界的创始者，是一位百万年前的11境乙木道体的至尊，
多重因素下，并蒂莲华体这种木属性道体在这种小地方，和顶级炉鼎体质没什么区别。
尤其是对于修炼魔道功法的人来说，更是大补之物。
于是，烟雨楼被树林界的第一大魔宗——血煞宗给盯上了。
血煞宗的宗主血无涯，是一个6境强者，修炼的功法需要采阴补阳。
他早就对秦月白垂涎三尺，只是碍于烟雨楼底蕴，加上并蒂莲华体木属性加成，又有‘女儿’秦婠婠合力，
两重灵力加持下，一时间也能算大半个6境，
就算是血无涯都得丈量丈量会不会吃力不讨好，最后被人摘了桃子。
可就在不久前，血无涯修炼魔功出了岔子，急需高品质炉鼎来疗伤，顺便突破瓶颈。
于是，他将目光彻底锁定在了秦月白和秦婠婠母女身上。
他给烟雨楼下达了最后通牒，七日之内，让秦月白带着秦婠婠亲自到血煞宗请罪，
否则便要踏平烟雨楼，鸡犬不留。
“七日之期？算算时间，今天是第三日吧。”
江渊眉头一皱。
“没错，”江战点头，“方才动用的是我们江家在中千世界的巡天殿，用破界传送阵将消息传递回来，树林界距离我们太过遥远，时间恐怕有点勉强。”
“也就是说，如果我们再不去，这对母女花就要被那什么血无涯给糟蹋了？”
江渊的脸沉了下来。
妈的！
老子看上的女人，你也敢动？
活腻歪了吧！
“渊儿别急。”
江守拙安慰道，“区区一个下界魔头而已，家主已经准备派人过去了，使用我江家的帝仙舟的话，还是来得及的。”
“派谁去？准圣？还是大圣？”江渊问道。
“福生就行了，他一个13境大圣，还是圣人王，就算中千世界都是横扫的。”
江战说道。
content_en:
"The situation is not good?" Jiang Yuan raised his eyebrows, "How should I say?"
Jiang Zhan waved his hand, and the detailed information about Yanyu Tower in the forest world turned into a flow of information and poured into Jiang Yuan's mind.
The forest world is just an inconspicuous existence among three thousand small worlds.
The level of cultivation in this world is extremely low;
The strongest person is only in the sixth level of magical power, and is not even qualified to ascend to the middle thousand worlds.
As for Yanyu Tower, it is only a first-rate sect in the forest world. The owner of the building, Qin Yuebai, is at the peak of the fifth realm of law and is already the strongest in the sect.
Originally, with the strength of Yanyu Tower, it would be safe to live a small life in a corner.
The only bad thing is Qin Yuebai's lotus body.
These two physiques may be nothing in the world of Emperor Immortal, but the spiritual energy of the wood path in the forest world is prosperous.
A Tao body with strong wood attributes, such as the Bingdi Lotus Body, has a strong combat power bonus.
In addition, the founder of the forest world was a supreme master of the Yimu Taoist body in the 11th realm millions of years ago.
Due to multiple factors, a wooden Taoist body like Bingdi Lotus Body is no different from a top-level Furnace Cauldron body in such a small place.
Especially for those who practice magic techniques, it is a great tonic.
As a result, Yanyulou was targeted by the largest demon sect in the forest world - the Blood Evil Sect.
The leader of the Blood Evil Sect, Xue Wuya, is a strong man in the sixth realm. The skills he practices require gathering yin and replenishing yang.
He had long coveted Qin Yuebai, but due to the background of Yanyu Tower, the attribute bonus of Bingdi Lotus Body Wood, and the combined efforts of his 'daughter' Qin Huan,
With the blessing of two levels of spiritual power, it can cover most of the six realms in one time.
Even Xue Wuya has to measure and measure whether it will be thankless and end up being picked off the peach.
But not long ago, something went wrong in Xue Wuya's magic practice, and he was in urgent need of a high-quality cauldron to heal his injuries and break through the bottleneck.
Therefore, he completely set his sights on Qin Yuebai and Qin Hanhan's mother and daughter.
He gave an ultimatum to Yanyulou. Within seven days, he asked Qin Yuebai to take Qin Hanhan to the Blood Evil Sect to plead guilty.
Otherwise, the Yanyu Tower will be leveled and no chickens or dogs will be left.
"Seven days? Calculate the time, today is the third day."
Jiang Yuan frowned.
"That's right," Jiang Zhan nodded, "What we just used was our Jiang family's Xuantian Palace in the Middle Thousand World, using the boundary-breaking teleportation array to send the message back. The forest boundary is too far away from us, and I'm afraid the time is a bit tight."
"That is to say, if we don't go, the mother and daughter will be ruined by that Xue Wuya?"
Jiang Yuan's face darkened.
Oh shit!
Do you dare to touch the woman I like?
Are you tired of living?
"Yuan'er, don't worry."
Jiang Shouzhuo comforted him, "It's just a demon from the lower realm. The master of the family has already prepared to send someone there. If we use my Jiang family's Emperor Immortal Boat, we can still make it in time."
"Who to send? Quasi-sage? Or great sage?" Jiang Yuan asked.
"Fu Sheng is enough. He is a 13th-level great saint and a saint king. He can sweep through thousands of worlds."
Jiang Zhan said.
title_en: Chapter 21 Of course, I will rescue the mother-daughter flower myself. Chapter 22 The luxurious bodyguard group capable of destroying Zhongqian World sets off.
